hypotheses.reasoning: payment-svc-reconciler transaction 98979 sat idle in transaction while holding a RowExclusiveLock on orders. Charge UPDATEs waited behind that lock and hit the 10s statement timeout, so order-service's calls to payment-svc timed out. That backed up the payment-svc HTTP pool (50/50 in use) and the gateway started returning 504s.
The payment-svc HTTP pool filled up, but only after the lock waits had started.

verdict.recommendedAction: Terminate postgres transaction 98979 (application_name payment-svc-reconciler) using pg_terminate_backend. Fix the reconciler so it doesn't leave transactions open and idle, and set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout.
